report:
I'd merge this. I found nothing the contributor has to fix.

**What I ran**
- `npm test` (Playwright with headless Chrome): `# tests 45 … # pass 45 # fail 0`.
- `prettier --check .`: `All matched files use Prettier code style!`.
- My own probe script, run from a `mktemp -d` directory. It found no sideways scroll on any of the four pages at 360px or at 320px (`scrollWidth` equals the viewport width every time). Loading `books.html?genre=poetry#main` shows "Showing 2 of 14 books", and the filter buttons are in the keyboard tab order.
- Colour contrast for the main pairs passes WCAG AA. Muted text on the hero band is 6.48:1, white on the pressed filter button is 11.58:1, error text is 7.02:1, and field borders on white are 3.75:1.
- `git status` is the same 21 added files as when I started. I wrote nothing into the repo.

**Checked against the issue**
- **Pages and nav:** all four pages exist and share a nav that marks the current page with `aria-current`. `index.html` is at the repo root.
- **Catalogue:** 14 titles across 6 genres. The filter uses toggle buttons with `aria-pressed`, keeps the genre in the URL, and Back and Forward work. A bad or hostile `?genre=` value falls back to All without errors.
- **Events and visit:** the events page lists upcoming events. The visit page has an hours table with row headers, an `<address>`, phone and email links, and a contact form. The form has labels, sets `aria-invalid` and `aria-describedby` on errors, moves focus to the first bad field, and says plainly that it is a demo.
- **No external requests:** the code makes none. The favicon is `data:,`, the fonts are system fonts, and a test asserts no off-origin requests and no POSTs.
- **Accessibility basics:** each page has a skip link, visible focus styles, and a reduced-motion rule. The mobile menu sets `aria-expanded` and closes on Escape.
- **Tests and docs:** the new behaviour has tests, and the README matches what the code does.

**Nits (not blocking)**
- The home page's "Coming up" teaser hard-codes the 5 December 2026 event instead of reading `js/events-data.js`, so the two can drift apart. Events also aren't filtered by date, so past events will keep showing as "upcoming".
- The ✓ on the pressed filter button is CSS `::before` content, so screen readers may read "check mark" on top of the pressed state.
- The `js` class that hides the mobile menu is added by a module script, which runs late. On phones the full nav can flash before it collapses.
- The locale is mixed: a `+1 (555)` phone number and `$` prices next to a UK-style postcode (`BW4 2QL`) and "favour".
- The table caption "Opening hours" repeats the `<h2>` just above it.
